reviewed_by: Claude: goal check-in reminder addendum source, focused backend selection
reason: Stacked on #1303 (baseline is its branch tip). A running goal that has posted no Work check-in for N minutes (default 30) or made M tool calls in its turn since its last check-in or reminder (default 40) is reminded once per window inside the running turn. CheckinReminder is a new GoalAddenda source: provider turns receive it as a Core-added goal.read result before the next routing call; harness turns are steered from the gateway tool-call bookkeeping hook (_attach_gateway_tool_call) and a successful work.check_in resets the count; Grok is not reminded. The last reminder is kept in goal metadata so the goal's next turn does not repeat it. Only turns offered the Work check-in tool are reminded; tools are never refused and Butler is not involved. Selected: the new regression file (due by time once per window and across turns, due by tool count, check-ins from the session, assigned items and Butler reports reset it, in-turn check-in resets the count, no Work tools means no reminder, bounded env thresholds, harness steer/reset/Grok, and one real routing-loop turn), #1303's addenda file, goal lifecycle, harness goals, Core delivery steps, turn tool bookkeeping and the harness Work gateway (both touched by the harness hook), and goal tool budgets.
exclusions: No frontend, native or Playwright change: the reminder has no UI control and appears as an existing goal.read transcript step, so those layers are empty. The settings-assistant document gains a behaviour row (the product knowledge index was rebuilt and verified locally); no destination or settingsCatalog entry is added because nothing is configurable in the UI. Real-Core Playwright is not selected: the provider journey was exercised on a disposable LAN Core. The harness steer is covered by pytest only. No full-suite approval.
